blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 59 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 15, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: CVVY & MRNA lead 59 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 22 Canadian and 37 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 15, 2026) found 59 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 22 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 8 of them new to the list this week. Cavvy Energy Ltd. (CVVY) leads with a +118% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 8 names.

In the U.S., 37 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 25 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +341% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 14 names.
